scope: No asset, flat mathematical support fixture only; no live scene, friction, inertia or actual seat
point_kind: uniform-volume CG if closed and oriented, otherwise centered AABB assumed for rejection proxy only
screening_gate: 10mm CG inside support hull; 100mm² projected clipped bearing; 20mm minimum site edge; plus actual coplanar non-point simultaneous support; never accept based on tolerance hull alone
termination: Screen did not prove physical-bearing support. Exact simultaneous sampled contacts remain point-like unless three+ noncollinear coplanar contacts with robust patch and torque proxy are shown; this discrete grid is not a global exclusion.
